{{Quote|Nix Jerd ‒ that's our bombardier.|Paige Tico|<ref name="Bomber" />}}
'''Nix Jerd''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] world [[Lantillies]]<ref name="Databank" /> who served as a [[bombardier]] in the [[Resistance]]'s [[Cobalt Squadron]].<ref name="Cobalt Squadron" /> He kept a firm grip on the release trigger of the [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|Resistance bomber]] ''[[Cobalt Hammer]]'', ready to release the [[bomber]]s payload onto [[First Order]] targets.<ref name="Databank" /> He was [[Death|killed]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> [[Paige Tico]] later called Jerd to check if he was okay, but received no response.<ref name="TLJ Adaptation 1">[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]]</ref> A short while after, Tico came across a deceased Nix in her attempt to drop the bomber's payload.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> After Jerd's death, his [[helmet]] was recovered and worn by his friend [[Enanan Supa]] whilst she was [[Resistance pilot|piloted]] a [[B-wing Mark III]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Nix Jerd was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> with light skin, dark-[[color]]ed hair and eyes.<ref name="Bomber" /> He was emotionless during tense situations,<ref name="IncrediBuilds">''[[Star Wars: Resistance Bomber Book and 3D Wood Model]]''</ref> so was usually calm and unaffected when his [[Cobalt Hammer|bomber]] was under attack. However, when things got too intense, he liked to yell at [[pilot]] [[Finch Dallow]] "a lot" according to [[gunner]] [[Paige Tico]]. He had a good head for numbers<ref name="Bomber" /> and mental calculations.<ref name="IncrediBuilds" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Nix-Jerd-helmet-TLJVD.png|thumb|right|200px|Jerd's flight helmet]]
Nix Jerd wore a [[Color|yellow]] [[flight suit]] with a white vest, [[harness]], [[life support]] system, gray [[glove]]s and black boots. He wore a gray, red and yellow [[flight helmet]], which bore a white [[Rebel Alliance starbird]] and was inscribed with [[Aurebesh]] lettering {{AurText|SBS./}} that translated to "SBS./".<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
